correction_reason: A test-first audit reproduced two fail-open evidence-state defects in the shared collector. Closed lifecycle resolution was computed before leaf fill, protection, cost, outcome, and exit-attribution validation completed, and an open lifecycle missing entry or protective-stop evidence remained labeled tracking_open_lifecycle. V5 computes completion only after every required leaf is checked and promotes incomplete open evidence to technical_evidence_pending. The V57 HYPE identity, route, sides, entry and exit contract, original prospective cutoff, and readiness baseline remain unchanged.

prospective_boundary.selection_rule: Subtract the cumulative readiness baseline and accept only lifecycles whose attributed signal decision_time_ms is at or after capture_start_ms.

minimum_diagnostic_evidence.long: At least one post-boundary attributable eligible long decision and fully resolved long lifecycle.
minimum_diagnostic_evidence.short: At least one post-boundary attributable eligible short decision and fully resolved short lifecycle.
required_fields: entry signal identity and decision timestamp
fees, funding, slippage, margin, holding duration, exit attribution, excursion, giveback, and net PnL

validation_completed.prospective_boundary: pre-activation decisions are excluded and readiness is baseline-adjusted
validation_completed.wrapped_provider_attribution: HYPE fails closed if another executable HYPE provider creates ambiguity
validation_completed.closed_leaf_resolution: missing fill leaves remain unresolved and cannot satisfy either side minimum
validation_completed.open_protection_state: missing open-lifecycle stop evidence produces technical_evidence_pending
validation_completed.single_and_bidirectional_state: short-only and long-plus-short requirements remain explicit
validation_completed.publication_integrity: preregistration and generator identities are checked before evaluation and immediately before immutable writing
validation_completed.file_limits: 82, 500, 164, and 353 lines for the four runtime modules
validation_completed.function_limits: all touched runtime and test functions are at most 50 lines

failure_modes_and_falsifiers: Current readiness totals regress behind the frozen baseline.
A pre-boundary HYPE decision appears in prospective progress.
The wrapped HYPE route is no longer uniquely attributable on the symbol.
Any live identity, side configuration, preregistration, or generator hash changes.
An eligible decision remains unattributed or a lifecycle lacks required evidence.
A closed lifecycle with any missing required leaf is labeled fully resolved.
An open lifecycle lacking entry or accepted protective-stop evidence is not labeled technical_evidence_pending.
The tracker changes live behavior or treats its diagnostic minimum as promotion evidence.
decision: Continue exact report-only HYPE long and short lifecycle collection under V5 without modifying V57.

confidence.evidence_mechanics: high after direct red-green regression and focused integration verification
confidence.hype_profitability: low because no post-boundary eligible decision or lifecycle exists
